lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਮਰੁ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਨ ਚਲਈ ਨ ਹੁਜਤਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: amar veparavaahu hai tis naal siaanap na chalaee na hujat karanee jaai ||
lines.translation: The Order of the Lord is beyond challenge. Clever tricks and arguments will not work against it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਮੰਨਿ ਲਏ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap chhod saranaai pavai ma(n)n lae rajaai ||
lines.translation: So abandon your self-conceit, and take to His Sanctuary; accept the Order of His Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jam da(n)d na lagaee haumai vichahu jaai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh eliminates self-conceit from within himself; he shall not be punished by the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੋਈ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sevak soee aakheeai j sach rahai liv laai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he alone is called a selfless servant, who remains lovingly attuned to the True Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਾਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਭ ਸੂਰਤਿ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: daat jot sabh soorat teree ||
lines.translation: All gifts, light and beauty are Yours.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahut siaanap haumai meree ||
lines.translation: Excessive cleverness and egotism are mine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu karam kamaavahi lobh mohi viaape haumai kade na chookai pheree ||
lines.translation: The mortal performs all sorts of rituals in greed and attachment; engrossed in egotsim, he shall never escape the cycle of reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰਤਾ ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ਗਲ ਚੰਗੇਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aap karaae karataa jo tis bhaavai saaee gal cha(n)geree ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Creator Himself inspires all to act. Whatever pleases Him is good. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Pauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach khaanaa sach painanaa sach naam adhaar ||
lines.translation: Let Truth be your food, and Truth your clothes, and take the Support of the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਮੇਲਾਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai melaaiaa prabh devanahaar ||
lines.translation: The True Guru shall lead you to meet God, the Great Giver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਗੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਜਾਗਿਆ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaag pooraa tin jaagiaa japiaa nira(n)kaar ||
lines.translation: When perfect destiny is activated, the mortal meditates on the Formless Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਲਗਿਆ ਤਰਿਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)gat lagiaa tariaa sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall cross over the world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥੩੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak siphat salaah kar prabh kaa jaikaar ||35||
lines.translation: O Nanak, chant God's Praises, and celebrate His Victory. ||35||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਜੀਅ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe jee samaal apanee mihar kar ||
lines.translation: In Your Mercy, You care for all beings and creatures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਮੁਚੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਦੁਖ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਭੰਨਿ ਤਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)n paanee much upaai dukh daalad bha(n)n tar ||
lines.translation: You produce corn and water in abundance; You eliminate pain and poverty, and carry all beings across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਦਾਤਾਰਿ ਹੋਈ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਠਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aradaas sunee daataar hoee sisat thar ||
lines.translation: The Great Giver listened to my prayer, and the world has been cooled and comforted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੇਵਹੁ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਗਾਇ ਅਪਦਾ ਸਭ ਹਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: levahu ka(n)th lagaai apadaa sabh har ||
lines.translation: Take me into Your Embrace, and take away all my pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਘਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam dhiaai prabh kaa saphal ghar ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the House of God is fruitful and prosperous. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੁਠੇ ਮੇਘ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੇ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: vuthe megh suhaavane hukam keetaa karataar ||
lines.translation: Rain is falling from the clouds - it is so beautiful! The Creator Lord issued His Order.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਿਜਕੁ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਅਗਲਾ ਠਾਂਢਿ ਪਈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: rijak upaaion agalaa thaa(n)dh paee sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Grain has been produced in abundance; the world is cooled and comforted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man hariaa hoiaa simarat agam apaar ||
lines.translation: The mind and body are rejuvenated, meditating in remembrance on the Inaccessible and Infinite Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa prabh aapanee sache sirajanahaar ||
lines.translation: O my True Creator Lord God, please shower Your Mercy on me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਹਿ ਸੋ ਕਰਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: keetaa loRahi so karahi naanak sad balihaar ||2||
lines.translation: He does whatever He pleases; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਆਪਿ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaa aap aga(n)m hai vadee vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: The Great Lord is Inaccessible; His glorious greatness is glorious!

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee vekh vigasiaa a(n)tar saa(n)t aaee ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon Him through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I blossom forth in ecstasy; tranquility comes to my inner being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh aape aap varatadaa aape hai bhaaee ||
lines.translation: All by Himself, He Himself is pervading everywhere, O Siblings of Destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨਾਥੁ ਸਭ ਨਥੀਅਨੁ ਸਭ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap naath sabh natheean sabh hukam chalaaee ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Lord and Master of all. He has subdued all, and all are under the Hukam of His Command.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਸਭ ਚਲੈ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੩੬॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak har bhaavai so kare sabh chalai rajaaee ||36||1|| sudh ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Lord does whatever He pleases. Everyone walks in harmony with His Will. ||36||1|| Sudh||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸਾਰੰਗ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag saara(n)g baanee bhagataa(n) kee || kabeer jee ||
lines.translation: Raag Saarang, The Word Of The Devotees. Kabeer Jee:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਾ ਨਰ ਗਰਬਸਿ ਥੋਰੀ ਬਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahaa nar garabas thoree baat ||
lines.translation: O mortal, why are you so proud of small things?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਦਸ ਨਾਜੁ ਟਕਾ ਚਾਰਿ ਗਾਂਠੀ ਐਂਡੌ ਟੇਢੌ ਜਾਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man das naaj takaa chaar gaa(n)thee ai(n)dau tedhau jaat ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: With a few pounds of grain and a few coins in your pocket, you are totally puffed up with pride. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਗਾਂਉ ਸਉ ਪਾਏ ਦੁਇ ਲਖ ਟਕਾ ਬਰਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahut prataap gaa(n)u sau paae dui lakh takaa baraat ||
lines.translation: With great pomp and ceremony, you control a hundred villages, with an income of hundreds of thousands of dollars.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਵਸ ਚਾਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੀ ਜੈਸੇ ਬਨ ਹਰ ਪਾਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: divas chaar kee karahu saahibee jaise ban har paat ||1||
lines.translation: The power you exert will last for only a few days, like the green leaves of the forest. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋਊ ਲੈ ਆਇਓ ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਾ ਕੋਊ ਲੈ ਜਾਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa kooo lai aaio ihu dhan naa kooo lai jaat ||
lines.translation: No one has brought this wealth with him, and no one will take it with him when he goes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਵਨ ਹੂੰ ਤੇ ਅਧਿਕ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਗਏ ਬਿਲਾਤ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: raavan hoo(n) te adhik chhatrapat khin mahi gae bilaat ||2||
lines.translation: Emperors, even greater than Raawan, passed away in an instant. ||2||
